local_review.finding_body: FS-test-contract.4.5 forbids tests that target URL/plugin/OSGi class-loader paths. BundleDelegatingClassLoaderTest directly constructs CXF's OSGi BundleDelegatingClassLoader with a fake Bundle and custom ResourceAliasClassLoader, then invokes loadClass and getResource (lines 30-48); build.gradle adds org.osgi.core solely for that scenario. I considered a contribution-local repair, but the scenario itself is forbidden and it currently passes all recorded lanes, so deleting or rewriting it to unrelated behavior would weaken a passing generated test, which FS-contribution-contract.5.1 also forbids. The sanctioned unsupported-scenario removal does not apply because there is no unverifiable Native Image refusal. A maintainer must decide how to reconcile this passing OSGi fallback scenario with the contract.
local_review.finding_title: Generated test directly targets an OSGi class-loader path
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test sources, build configuration, metadata-file shape, local gate records, and resolved statistics. The index gates passed and dynamic-access coverage is 48/50 (96%), but the OSGi class-loader test violates the Native Image test contract, so the contribution cannot be approved.
